meta.title: Signal flow, mic to speaker
meta.intro: Read it left to right. Sources plug into stage boxes, everything meets on the one Dante network in the middle, and the consoles send mixes out to the PA, the IEMs and broadcast. Card glow shows the equipment type and line style shows the cable.
meta.footnote: Arrows show signal direction. Dante is two-way; every dot on the center bar is one Dante port.
